c.title: $4,450 / 2br - 1080ft2 - Yaletown 2 bed/2 bath (Yaletown)
c.description:
This high-elevation corner residence boasts stunning views of False Creek, historic Yaletown, and cityscape, which can be enjoyed from all vantage points. As well, an abundance of natural light is assured with West and South and North exposures.

This sought-after floor plan is available. Immaculate condition and being offered furnished.

The welcoming kitchen features rift-cut oak cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, a gas cook-top, honed black granite counter surfaces, as well as a large center island with a butcher block surface.

Hardwood flooring in principal rooms, upgraded contemporary roller blinds on all windows, and custom closet organizers in this highly intelligent floor plan which measures 1,080 square feet.

Bathrooms are furnished with marble counter surfaces, dark rift-cut cabinetry, Flaminia basins, backlit vanity mirrors, and dual basins in the en suite.

Two covered view balconies with new wood decking are also featured and are accessible from principal rooms and the primary bedroom.

The Domus, a meticulously managed address that features a well-appointed fitness facility, a newly refurbished lounge and associated outdoor, a guest suite, and attentive building services.

This superb location is home to some of the city's best restaurants, cafes, eclectic shops, and recreation-nothing to do but move in and enjoy.
